title: Research: F17 pair-kernel bill at the exact F0/B1 entry width (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded bill under priority revision 6, card `joint-query-controller`. The selected stock coefficient is already registered (`8194`, `6748`, and the lcm reserve), so this package does not recompute it.

At the exact F0 then B₁,₂ entry parameters `λ=1`, `f=64`, `e=0`, `β=64`, the inherited contract gives decoder width `W=532`. The F17 zero-retention decoder's runtime pair kernel is at most `26744256 λ N D` gates, and its 464 named fields use at most `493696 N D` data bits. The registered dirty-helper magnitude ledger does not supply that width: a norm bound does not determine the adaptive line exponent.

**Partial arithmetic bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Scans, scalar ADDs, wrappers, maps, addressing, movement and cleanup remain unpaid.

## Result

Package: `research/qq16-f17-pair-bill/`.
Tip: `8514cdf994b0a90bfb3a19a4c9d3a32b2c911e4d`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/qq16-f17-pair-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/qq16-f17-pair-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/qq16-f17-pair-bill/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/qq16-f17-pair-bill/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-f17-pair-bill
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_QQ16_F17_PAIR_BILL W=532 gates_per_pair=159192 pair_kernel=26744256*lambda*N*D field_bits=493696*N*D dirty_width=unsupplied control_gates=124028
PASS_QQ16_F17_PAIR_BILL_INDEPENDENT W=532 gates_per_pair=159192 pair_kernel=26744256*lambda*N*D field_bits=493696*N*D dirty_width=unsupplied
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-f17-pair-bill outcome=partial
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

`W=532` is the published example in `research/qq16-producer-entry-contract`. This package binds that width to the PR2811 pair-gate formula and the PR2807 field-bit formula, and records that the rounded-producer dirty ledger does not supply the grid. It does not reopen [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349), the deferred V45 histogram, or the merged readout series through [#2883](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2883).

Credit Nick Petalas (#2965, the entry contract, PR2807, PR2811, and the rounded envelope), ywz65 (PR2707), and the retained F0/B₁,₂ authors.
